scenarios.evidence: exact-brand tensile, flexural, compression, TDS, and room-temperature topology references
scenarios.reason: Use only the documented pre-peak/short-term envelope; no creep, fatigue, or environmental extrapolation.

scenarios.evidence: peer-reviewed exact-brand DMA at 30 degC and 1 Hz
scenarios.reason: Storage modulus is supported; loss modulus, damping, resonance, strength, and long-time response are not.

scenarios.evidence: exact-brand raw DMA master curve and reported G'/G'' at 18 degC over 1 Hz to 25 kHz
scenarios.reason: Small-strain storage stiffness and a representative loss factor are supported for bounded wave/modal screening.

scenarios.evidence: positive generalized-Maxwell fit to the exact-brand 18 C reduced-frequency master curve
scenarios.reason: Storage fit and spectrum positivity pass within the inverse measured-frequency window; loss precision does not pass, so this is a sensitivity rather than a creep validation.

scenarios.evidence: exact-brand Tg/HDT thresholds exist, but no service-temperature constitutive curve
scenarios.reason: The temperature is below HDT but outside the measured room-temperature material-card envelope.

scenarios.evidence: Bambu TDS V3.0: HDT 54 degC at 1.8 MPa, 57 degC at 0.45 MPa; Tg 60 degC
scenarios.reason: The condition reaches or exceeds the lowest published heat-deflection boundary. The room-temperature material cards must not be extrapolated here.

scenarios.evidence: Bambu TDS V3.0: HDT 54 degC at 1.8 MPa, 57 degC at 0.45 MPa; Tg 60 degC
scenarios.reason: The condition reaches or exceeds the lowest published heat-deflection boundary. The room-temperature material cards must not be extrapolated here.

scenarios.evidence: no exact-brand creep compliance or Prony series
scenarios.reason: A rate-independent elastic/plastic card cannot predict time-dependent deformation.

scenarios.evidence: no exact-brand S-N, strain-life, or cyclic-damage law
scenarios.reason: Monotonic strength is not a fatigue-life model.

scenarios.evidence: Bambu TDS V3.0 reports 0.43% saturated absorption at 25 degC/55% RH but no mechanical correction
scenarios.reason: Water uptake is known, but its effect on modulus, strength, interfaces, and creep is not identified.

scenarios.evidence: manufacturer impact values and a peer-reviewed narrow 354-368 m/s exact-brand ballistic validation
scenarios.reason: Evidence can rank the published cases but does not define a general strain-rate law.

supported_contract: short-term monotonic simulation at 20-30 degC in the documented dry/as-printed or manufacturer-conditioned state
18 degC / 40% RH small-strain relaxation sensitivity from 6.37 microseconds to 0.159 seconds
published impact/ballistic cases as bounded screens only
prohibited_contract: no extrapolation at or above 54 degC
no constant-load creep or stress relaxation beyond the bounded sub-second sensitivity
no humidity or water-uptake mechanical correction
